Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface ModelTextures

@CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") public interface ModelTextures
Editor-backed projection of the active model's texture library.

Reads reflect the Editor's CTextureManager document state. Writes are Editor-authoring operations executed inside the native Undo envelope (edit-mode begin/end with a registered GroupUndo); every write is undoable through the Editor's Undo history. Common texture-library operations require the corresponding read or write capability from an admitted texture contract. On later versions the write contract must also match the native edit, Undo, rollback and refresh dependencies. Raw-image removal requires an admitted non-dialog native route selected from the matched mapping.

    • exportRawImagePsd

      @CubismEditor({"5.2.00","5.2.01","5.2.02","5.2.03","5.3.00","5.3.01","5.3.02","5.3.03","5.3.04"}) default CompletionStage<PsdExportResult> exportRawImagePsd(RawImageId source)
      Exports one explicitly identified raw image to a runtime-owned PSD handle.

      The export is Cubism's native layered-image rebuild of its current resources, not a byte copy of the originally imported file. Only saves of the issued handle are observable to PsdEditFile.observeSaves(java.util.function.Consumer<dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.psd.PsdFileRevision>); saving under a different name or path in the external application is not tracked.

      Implementations that do not own the native PSD service return a completed typed PsdExportResult.Status.UNAVAILABLE result. The default never invokes a file handle or accepts a caller-supplied path.

    • replaceRawImagePsd

      @CubismEditor({"5.2.00","5.2.01","5.2.02","5.2.03","5.3.00","5.3.01","5.3.02","5.3.03","5.3.04"}) default CompletionStage<PsdReplaceResult> replaceRawImagePsd(RawImageId target, PsdEditFile file, PsdFileRevision revision)
      Replaces one explicitly identified raw image from a runtime-issued PSD revision.

      A raw image shared by several model images or ArtMeshes is replaced once and every dependent object observes the new content; the native matcher performs the merge, not the caller.

      Implementations that do not own the native PSD service return a completed typed PsdReplaceResult.Status.UNAVAILABLE result. The default does not inspect or invoke either opaque argument.

    • removeRawImage

      @CubismEditor({"5.0.00","5.0.01","5.0.02","5.0.03","5.0.04","5.0.05","5.0.06","5.1.00","5.1.01","5.1.02","5.1.03","5.2.00","5.2.01","5.2.02","5.2.03","5.3.00","5.3.01","5.3.02","5.3.03","5.3.04"}) void removeRawImage(RawImageId id)
      Removes one raw layered image and its layer inputs by id, retaining the model images, ArtMeshes and texture atlases. The 5.0–5.2 routes compose exact native Undo factories; the 5.3 routes use the native non-cascading handler. No confirmation dialog is opened.

    • registerImageAndBind

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default ModelImageBinding registerImageAndBind(AuthorizedImageContent image, ArtMeshId target)
      Registers one authorized image as a raw layered image plus model image and binds it to an unbound ArtMesh inside a single Editor authoring transaction (registration contribution before the binding contribution).

      The image grant is consumed by the call. The target must be an existing, unlocked, unbound ArtMesh with no extension and no parent deformer. On any rejection or partial failure the model is left untouched.

      Returns:
      the detached registration/binding handle

    • bindModelImage

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default ModelImageBinding bindModelImage(ModelImageId image, ArtMeshId target)
      Binds an already-registered model image to an unbound ArtMesh.

      Binding the same image to the same ArtMesh again is a no-change operation that touches no native state. Binding a different image to an ArtMesh that already carries a texture-input extension, or any extension not created by this slice, is rejected.

      Returns:
      the detached binding handle

    • textureInput

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default Optional<ArtMeshTextureInput> textureInput(ArtMeshId target)
      Observes the native texture input currently bound to one ArtMesh.

      Reads the mesh's texture-input extension and reports the authored resource it resolves to — a model image or a texture atlas region — under the active model generation. The observation is detached: it never exposes host objects and is not a write token. An empty result means the mesh genuinely carries no extension or no current input; a missing target, an unresolvable or foreign resource, or an unknown input kind fails instead of reporting unbound. This is authoring binding identity, not a render texture index and not proof of sampling.

    • supportsAppendTextureAtlasPages

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default boolean supportsAppendTextureAtlasPages()
      Reports whether append-only texture atlas authoring is available in the active runtime.

      Callers should query this capability before opening an authoring transaction so that unsupported environments fail early before creating meshes or parameters.

      Returns:
      true if append-only atlas creation and layout is supported

    • appendTextureAtlasPages

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default List<TextureAtlasId> appendTextureAtlasPages(AtlasPageAppendPlan plan)
      Appends new texture-atlas pages with the given placements to the model's texture atlas library, preserving all existing atlas pages, entries, IDs, and UVs.

      When called inside an active authoring transaction, this mutation joins the ambient transaction scope and rolls back atomically on failure. Outside a transaction, it executes in a standalone native Undo envelope.

      Parameters:
      plan - the append-only layout plan specifying page dimensions, page count, and model-image placements
      Returns:
      the list of stable IDs for the newly created and appended atlas pages
